dedupe_keys.name: glosofarid global multispectral dataset for solar farm identification in satellite imagery

description: Northeastern University researchers publish GloSoFarID, labelled multispectral satellite samples of solar farms. Zenodo provides five compressed TFRecord files free under CC BY 4.0. The linked repository documents 13,703 positive and negative samples from global and US subsets during 2021–2023, with 256-by-256-pixel inputs, thirteen spectral bands and binary solar-panel masks. The supplied grid spacing is ten metres. These samples can train asset-detection components used to construct renewable-infrastructure inventories for simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this labelled collection. Sample coverage is not a complete census of solar capacity, and pixel spacing does not establish equal native resolution across spectral bands. Spatial or temporal overlap can affect evaluation independence. Converter software has no identified repository licence. No imagery was downloaded, model trained or reported segmentation score reproduced.
